value.deck: Microsoft's cloud control tool now lets workers send specialized artificial intelligence (AI) assistants to handle tricky tasks directly.
shortVersion: Managing online computer systems can be complex and time-consuming. Microsoft is making this easier by letting people call on specialized artificial intelligence (AI) assistants inside their main work screen.

Instead of doing difficult technical work manually, workers can delegate specific jobs to these digital assistants. This keeps everything in one place and helps people handle complex cloud tasks without leaving their primary workspace.
value.plainLanguage: Azure Copilot now lets users invoke specialized AI assistants directly inside their cloud management tools to handle complex tasks.

keyTerms.meaning: A specialized artificial intelligence helper designed to handle specific tasks for you.
An artificial intelligence helper built into Microsoft's cloud tools to assist with managing computer systems.

value.whyItMatters: Managing online computer systems usually takes a lot of effort and switching between different screens. Giving workers direct access to specialized digital helpers makes complex tasks easier and keeps all work in one place.
watchNext: Watch for updates on which new specialized tasks these assistants will be able to handle.
Look out for feedback on how much time these built-in assistants save during daily cloud work.
